balanced_square.paired_effect_ci: bootstrap median of per-round pandas/FP ratios
balanced_square.outer_aa_null: first two versus final two placements per arm

host_wide_exclusivity_contract.checks: replaced by paired ABBAABBA slots on the shared host; foreign load is paired instead of used as admission

best_vs_best.definition: pandas_min_us / frankenpandas_min_us, over every timed sample in this invocation

arm_core_placement.same_cores_ensured_by: identical CPU mask applied to both arms (inherited); the pandas arm runs in this process and the FrankenPandas child is launched under `taskset -c 0-63`, so neither arm can be scheduled onto cores the other was excluded from

host_state.same_clock_note: sampled after each slot; an arm whose threads exit leaves cores ramping down, so the top-k median understates it

arm_cpu_attribution.attribution: busiest CPUs WITHIN THE ARM MASK by /proc/stat delta across the arm's slots; a proxy on a shared host, exact only for arms whose mask excludes other tenants

reasons: arms ran at different clocks (ratio 1.0637); the measured ratio carries a frequency term
